HALYARD AI SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT
SYNTHETIC EVAL SAMPLE: fictional vendor, written for testing. Not a real agreement.

1. Definitions. "Inputs" means content Customer submits to the Service. "Outputs" means content the Service generates. Inputs and Outputs together are "Customer Content".

2. Model Improvement. By default, Halyard may use Customer Content to improve and train its models. Customer may opt out at any time in the workspace settings, and the opt-out applies to Customer Content submitted after it takes effect.

3. Retention. Halyard retains Customer Content for 90 days on a rolling basis. Following termination, Halyard deletes Customer Content within 90 days.

4. Subprocessors. Halyard's subprocessors are listed in its documentation. Halyard will notify Customer of new subprocessors by updating that list, and Customer may object in writing within 15 days, in which case Halyard will work with Customer in good faith to address the objection.

5. Ownership. Customer owns its Outputs.

6. Confidentiality. Halyard will treat Customer Content as Customer's Confidential Information.

7. Security. Halyard maintains a SOC 2 Type II report and will notify Customer of a security breach affecting Customer Content within 72 hours.

8. IP Indemnity. Halyard will defend Customer against third-party claims that Outputs, as generated by the Service, infringe a third party's intellectual property rights.
